prompt: Using the attached images ONLY as a style reference (rendering, materials, lighting, palette, composition, background treatment) — do not copy their objects — create a new card illustration of a bright blue hero hall building with a giant arched entrance, cape-shaped roof and starburst window in its real environment: sunny downtown plaza with soft trees, pale sky and distant friendly skyscrapers; frontal, slightly from below; the object is the clear central hero and fills about 70-80% of the frame, tall or wide objects may be cropped by the frame edge, the environment is recognizable but simplified: a few large shapes of the landscape and sky with fluffy clouds, only a little secondary detail, softly blurred, bright daylight, no characters. Style: stylized 3D casual mobile game collectible card art, animated-movie look, soft rounded chunky shapes, slightly exaggerated proportions, no outlines, stylized material textures with medium detail, soft diffuse warm lighting, glossy highlights, soft contact shadow, the object is the most saturated element, background slightly softer, single object centered, fills about 75% of the width, top 12% of the frame kept clear, toy-like simplified forms with smooth surfaces, thick chunky parts instead of thin lattices or wires, no fine fibers or strands, no small scattered details. Vertical 9:10 composition. No text, letters, numbers, logos, frames, borders, rounded corners, card UI, stars, outlines, photorealism, dark gloomy tones, clutter, people, animals. Context of this card set: One day of a visitor in a superhero city: a sunny downtown plaza in the morning, a rooftop training terrace at noon, the rescue workshop in the afternoon, and a golden-hour hero hall by the skyline.. Let this context shape only the surface, environment and background mood; show no people, no animals and no other objects from that day.
